about.title: About Manhal
about.intro: Education can open doors, but finding the right one should not feel like a barrier.

sections.title: A clearer path to possibility
sections.body: Manhal brings universities, scholarships and student applications into one thoughtful experience. We help students explore credible opportunities and take the next step with confidence.

sections.title: Built around students
sections.body: From comparing programs to following an application, every part of the journey is designed to be understandable, welcoming and accessible.

sections.title: A future without borders
sections.body: We believe talent is everywhere. Our goal is to make the opportunities to learn and grow easier to discover, wherever a student begins.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: A few helpful answers to get you moving.

sections.title: Is it free to browse opportunities?
sections.body: Yes. You can explore universities, programs and scholarships without charge.

sections.title: How do I start an application?
sections.body: Create a student account, choose an open opportunity and follow its requirements. Keep your academic records and supporting documents ready.

sections.title: Can I apply to more than one program?
sections.body: Yes. You can prepare and track more than one application from your student account.

sections.title: How can I check my application status?
sections.body: Sign in to your account to see status updates and requests from the admissions team.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Your information should be treated with care and used only to support your education journey.

sections.title: Information in this demo
sections.body: This demonstration app uses fictional seed data and a mock session. Do not enter real personal, academic or identity information.

sections.title: How information is used
sections.body: In a production service, information would be used to manage applications, provide requested updates and improve access to educational opportunities.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: A production version should provide clear controls to access, correct or remove personal information and to manage communication preferences.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These demo terms explain how to use the Manhal prototype responsibly.

sections.title: Demonstration service
sections.body: Manhal is a prototype. Program details, deadlines, eligibility and universities shown here are sample data and must be confirmed with the institution before relying on them.

sections.title: No admission guarantee
sections.body: Submitting information through a demo does not constitute a real university application and does not guarantee admission or scholarship funding.

sections.title: Responsible use
sections.body: Use the demo respectfully and do not submit real sensitive information. Production use requires verified accounts, durable storage and institution-approved content.
